LHS.description: The Left Hand Side of the equation in LaTeX.

relation.description: The mathematical operator connecting LHS and RHS (usually '=').

RHS.description: The Right Hand Side of the equation in LaTeX.

condition.description: Specific constraints or values (e.g., t=0) under which the equation holds.

label.description: A unique identifier or name for the physics/math law.

sympy_LHS.description: SymPy-compatible string representation of the LHS.

sympy_RHS.description: SymPy-compatible string representation of the RHS.
